summary: xAI announced a partnership making Grok Voice the default text-to-speech and speech-to-text engine for Vapi's voice agent platform, which hosts over 2.5 million voice agents.

mechanisms.reason: Grok Voice becoming the default engine across millions of existing voice agents on a third-party platform expands the aggregate inference surface for the model.
mechanisms.quote: bringing a new level of naturalness and emotional range to the 2.5M+ voice agents built on the Vapi platform

practices.reason: An independent blind evaluation reportedly ranked Grok Voice #1 against other TTS providers, suggesting improved audio generation quality worth evaluating for voice products.
practices.quote: Vapi conducted an independent, blind evaluation comparing Grok Voice against other providers. In their head-to-head arena, Grok took the #1 spot.

practices.reason: Developers already on Vapi get Grok Speech-to-Text and Text-to-Speech exposed as selectable options in the dashboard, a new integration surface with no forced migration described.
practices.quote: Grok Speech-to-Text and Text-to-Speech are now available in the Vapi Dashboard.
